Peak Table Object

Source: R/peak_table-class.R
peak_table-class.Rd

S3 objects of class peak_table store chromatographic peak data along with associated metadata and reference spectra.

Components

A peak_table object contains the following elements:

  • tab: The peak table itself — a data.frame of intensities in a sample × peak configuration.

  • pk_meta: A data.frame containing peak metadata (e.g., the spectral component, peak number, and summarized retention time). See get_peaktable for its rows.

  • sample_meta: A data.frame of sample metadata: the fields added to the chromatograms with chromConverter::add_metadata() (chromConverter 0.11.0 or later), and any attached with attach_metadata. NA if there are none.

  • instrument_meta: A data.frame of instrumental metadata transferred automatically from the chromatograms.

  • ref_spectra: A matrix of reference spectra (in a wavelength × peak configuration). NA until added with attach_ref_spectra.

  • args: A list of the arguments given to get_peaktable to generate the peak table, with the peak list's fitting settings. See get_peaktable.

Methods

The following methods are available:

  • print.peak_table()

  • dim.peak_table()

  • head.peak_table()

  • tail.peak_table()

  • row.names.peak_table()

  • subset.peak_table()

  • summary.peak_table()

  • [.peak_table

See also

get_peaktable() for creating peak_table objects

Examples

# See get_peaktable() for creation examples
# To access peak_table components:
data(pk_tab)
pk_tab$tab          # peak table
